# Agent guide — Brand Design System

Nx monorepo that turns **design tokens** into a **brand-customised, publishable
Angular component library** on top of **ng-zorro-antd**. This file is the single
source of truth for agent guidance; `CLAUDE.md` imports it and
`.github/copilot-instructions.md` is generated from it (see the last section).

- **Stack:** Nx 20.8 · Angular 19 (standalone, signals, `OnPush`) · ng-zorro-antd 19 ·
  Style Dictionary 4 · Storybook 8 · Jest. Node **20.18** — do **not** bump to
  Angular 20 (its Node floor is 20.19).
- **Layering:** `@brand/tokens` → `@brand/theme` → `@brand/ui` → `apps/demo`.
  A package may only import from its own layer or below.

## Repository map

| Path | Package | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `libs/tokens` | `@brand/tokens` | Token source JSON + `nx build tokens` (Style Dictionary → `generated/{css,less,scss,ts,json}`). |
| `libs/theme` | `@brand/theme` | `BrandThemeService` / `provideBrandTheme()`, `base.css`, `ng-zorro-tokens.css`, and `nx run theme:styles` (compiles ng-zorro Less with the tokens as `modifyVars`). |
| `libs/ui` | `@brand/ui` | Atomic component library. Publishable via `nx build ui` (ng-packagr). Storybook lives here. |
| `apps/demo` | — | Demo app: `/` a compliance case queue, `/devices` a dashboard. |
| `docs/` | — | `theming.md`, `contributing.md`. |
| `scripts/` | — | Repo tooling, incl. `sync-agent-instructions.mjs`. |

Three placeholder brands: `brand-1` (blue), `brand-2` (violet), `brand-3`
(yellow `#ffdd00` / black). Switch at runtime via `data-brand` / `data-theme` on
`<html>`.

## Golden rules

- **Never hard-code a visual value.** Colours, spacing, radius, type, motion,
  elevation are all `var(--ds-*)` tokens. Missing one? Add a token, don't inline a
  hex.
- **Components are standalone + `ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush`**, use signal
  `input()` / `output()` / `model()`, and express variants as `data-*` **host
  attributes** styled with `:host([data-x='y'])`.
- **Form controls implement `ControlValueAccessor`.**
- **Respect the layer boundary** (`tokens → theme → ui → app`). `@brand/theme`
  must not build-time depend on `@brand/tokens` (types are duplicated in
  `libs/theme/src/lib/brand.types.ts` on purpose).
- **Verify before claiming done:** `npx nx run-many -t lint test build` must be
  green, and if the change is visible, check it in the running `demo` /
  Storybook.
- Co-locate `*.stories.ts` and `*.spec.ts` with each component.

## Commands

```bash
npm install
npx nx build tokens                       # regenerate token CSS/Less/TS after editing libs/tokens/src
npx nx run-many -t build                   # tokens → theme → ui → demo
npx nx serve demo                          # http://localhost:4200
npx nx storybook ui                        # component explorer, brand/scheme in the toolbar
npx nx run-many -t lint test build         # full gate (what CI runs, roughly)
npm run sync:agents                        # regenerate the Copilot files from AGENTS.md + skills
```

## Working in `libs/tokens`

- Sources are layered JSON under `src/`: `core/` primitives → `semantic/` roles
  (`color.action.primary`, …) → `brand/<name>.json` overrides → `theme/dark.json`.
- Reference lower layers with `{path.to.token}` (Style Dictionary alias syntax).
- Adding a brand: create `src/brand/<name>.json`, add the name to `BRANDS` in
  `style-dictionary.config.mjs`, and to the `Brand` union + `BRANDS` array in
  **both** `libs/tokens/src/index.ts` and `libs/theme/src/lib/brand.types.ts`
  (plus `BRAND_LABELS`).
- After any change run `npx nx build tokens`; it emits one `tokens.css` with a
  selector block per brand × scheme.
- The generated `generated/` folder is git-ignored and must never be edited by
  hand.

## Working in `libs/theme`

- `BrandThemeService` is the single source of truth for active brand + scheme; it
  mirrors state onto `<html>` and persists to `localStorage`. A visitor's saved
  choice always wins over `provideBrandTheme({ brand })` defaults.
- `brand.types.ts` and `brand-theme.config.ts` are dependency-light on purpose —
  keep `@angular/core` as the only import there.
- `ng-zorro-tokens.css` re-points the ng-zorro classes the design system exposes
  (`.ant-select`, `.ant-table`, `.ant-btn-*`, pagination, popovers) at `--ds-*`
  so raw ng-zorro also follows a brand switch. Add a rule here when you surface a
  new ng-zorro widget.
- `nx run theme:styles` compiles `generated/antd.css` + `generated/antd-dark.css`
  via `build-antd-theme.mjs` (needs `less` with `javascriptEnabled`).

## Writing a component in `libs/ui`

- Model new components on `atoms/button/button.component.ts` (the reference impl).
- **Wrap ng-zorro** when its behaviour / a11y / overlay handling is worth reusing
  and its surface can be re-pointed at tokens (`ds-select`). **Build native**
  when ng-zorro's compiled `.ant-*` specificity would pin the Ant palette and
  defeat runtime brand switching (`ds-button`).
- Do **not** put `<ng-content>` inside `@if` / `@switch` / `@for` — Angular
  projection breaks for repeated instances. Project into the host and switch
  semantics via attributes instead (see `atoms/text`).
- Export every public component/type from `libs/ui/src/index.ts`.
- Keep `ng-zorro-antd` a **peer** dependency of `@brand/ui` (CI enforces this).
- Add a `*.stories.ts` (a `Playground` + a variants gallery) and a `*.spec.ts`
  (behaviour + a11y attributes).

## The demo app (`apps/demo`)

- Pages live in `src/app/pages/<name>/<name>.component.ts`, standalone + `OnPush`,
  built only from `@brand/ui` (a raw `nz-table` is allowed to show ng-zorro is
  skinned too).
- `app.config.ts` wires `provideAnimations()`, `provideNzI18n`, `provideNzIcons`
  (register every icon name you use), and `provideBrandTheme({ brand: 'brand-3' })`.
- The build `styles` order is fixed: `tokens.css` → `antd.css` → `antd-dark.css`
  → `ng-zorro-tokens.css` → `base.css` → app styles.

## Keeping agent docs in sync

Edit **only** `AGENTS.md` and `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md`. Then:

```bash
npm run sync:agents
```

That regenerates `.github/copilot-instructions.md`,
`.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` (from sections marked
`<!-- copilot:applyTo=<glob> -->`), and `.github/prompts/*.prompt.md` (from each
skill). `npm run check:agents` fails if any are stale — CI runs it. Never
hand-edit the generated files; they carry a "GENERATED" banner.
